stories.title: Emirates XI shock Sussex to take title
stories.subTitle: Fly Emirates XI v Sussex, Dubai
stories.seoTitle: Emirates XI shock Sussex to take title
stories.summary: Arshad Ali, a visa services officer for the national airline, cleaned up with 3 for 7 to beat Sussex in a low-scoring final of the Emirates Airline Twenty20

stories.title: Emirates XI secure place in final
stories.subTitle: Fly Emirates XI v Cape Cobras XI, Dubai
stories.seoTitle: Emirates XI secure place in final
stories.summary: Shahid Afridi helped inspire a team full of baggage handlers and airline pursers to great things  as the Fly Emirates team beat the Emerging Cape Cobras to qualify for the final of the Emirates Airline Twenty20 festival

stories.title: Netherlands claim vital victory
stories.subTitle: UAE v Netherlands, Intercontinental Cup, Sharjah, 4th day
stories.summary: Netherlands overcame some stubborn lower-order resistance from UAE to complete a 64-run win in Sharjah, which keeps them in with a chance of reaching the final with two matches left
